original.text: uvasaggaharaṃ pāsaṃ pāsaṃ vaṃdāmi kammaghaṇamukkaṃ / visaharavisaninnāsaṃ maṃgalakallāṇaāvāsaṃ
original.edition: recalled by the unit author (wording believed standard; to be checked against an edition)

paraphrase: I bow to Pārśva, remover of calamities, attended by [the yakṣa] Pārśva, freed from the dense mass of karma, destroyer of the poison of snakes, abode of auspiciousness and welfare.
